metadata.title: Star formation in a galactic outflow

notes: No eligible stars. The paper studies star formation in the outflow of the extragalactic merging system IRAS F23128-5919 at redshift 0.0448 (T:p1-b11), not an individual Galactic unbound star. Although it discusses stellar populations in that galaxy's outflow and a ballistic model in which stars formed at projected distances greater than 1 kpc can become gravitationally unbound from that host galaxy (T:p3-b2; T:p9-b1), this is not candidacy as a Galactic unbound star, and no individual star identifiers are supplied.
